description: The Empire Inc. is a Tokyo-based IT technology consulting firm founded in 2013, specializing in cloud computing, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and DevOps practices. The company works with global clients on modern IT infrastructure and software development projects. Led by founder Zack (Daisuke) Dolby (Kitagawa), who also serves as Executive Officer at Toyo Kako Co., Ltd. and Board Member at Japan OpenStack User Group.
business_model: Project-based IT consulting and professional services for cloud infrastructure, DevOps transformation, and software development engagements with global clients.
leadership: Zack (Daisuke) Dolby (Kitagawa) - Founder, The Empire Inc.; Executive Officer, Toyo Kako Co., Ltd.; Board Member, Japan OpenStack User Group
value_proposition: Specialized expertise in cloud-native technologies, Infrastructure as Code, and DevOps practices with global delivery capability from Tokyo, backed by leadership involvement in OpenStack community.
rfp_strengths: Deep technical expertise in cloud computing and DevOps
Founder's leadership role in Japan OpenStack User Group indicates community recognition
Multi-language technology stack capability (Python, Java, JavaScript, Go)
rfp_weaknesses: Very small team (2-10 employees) limits capacity for large engagements
Limited public track record / case studies
Single location in Tokyo may challenge global delivery
opportunities: Growing demand for cloud migration and DevOps in Japan and APAC
OpenStack expertise aligns with private/hybrid cloud trends
Potential partnerships with major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP)
Expansion into managed services for recurring revenue
challenges: Competing with large SI firms and cloud provider professional services
Resource constraints for simultaneous large projects
